# LucidMark

> LucidMark manages Google Ads for UK local businesses. It is a trading name of Axonis Ltd (company number 16436487, London).

## What LucidMark does
- Free Google Ads audit: a score out of 100, the money at risk each month, the top 3 fixes and what's working.
- Ongoing management: conversion tracking, campaign setup, daily account checks, a weekly search-term clean-up, careful budget and bid changes, and ads written only from facts on the client's own website.
- A plain-English report by email every Monday.

## Prices (per month, ad spend paid to Google separately)
- Starter £499: ad spend up to £1,500
- Growth £750: £1,500 to £4,000
- Pro £999: £4,000 to £8,000
- Scale: 15% of ad spend over £8,000
- 3-month minimum, then month to month. The client owns their Google Ads account. No guaranteed results.
